shorts.title: This 25-Gram Octopus Has Enough Venom to Paralyze Ten Adults
shorts.outro: Doug picked one up anyway. See what happened in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID DOUG DO? TAP BELOW
shorts.description: The golf-ball-sized blue-ringed octopus carries tetrodotoxin made by bacteria in its saliva, there is no antivenom, and the bite is often painless, which is exactly the kind of animal Doug picks up.

shorts.hook: The most toxic snake on Earth has never killed anyone.
shorts.title: The World's Most Toxic Snake Has Zero Confirmed Kills
shorts.outro: Nine other venoms were not so shy. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: The inland taipan has the most toxic snake venom ever measured, yet every known bite victim survived with fast treatment, so Doug crosses the outback to meet it and gets ignored.

shorts.title: The Box Jellyfish Has Killed 63 People, and It Swims
shorts.outro: And it has twenty-four eyes. What it does to Doug is in the full video below.
shorts.description: NOAA calls the Australian box jellyfish the most venomous marine animal: up to sixty tentacles three meters long, at least 63 recorded deaths since 1884, and unlike most jellyfish it swims.
